description:
Activate Proteus Machine's morph ability by paying {0}, turning it face-up.
Proteus Machine triggers, causing it to become a Saproling.
Activate the sacrifice outlet by sacrificing Proteus Machine.
When Proteus Machine dies, Yedora triggers, returning Proteus Machine from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the sacrifice outlet's ability.
Activate Proteus Machine by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
